pageCache.text:
With God, all things are possible
Marden Vale
As Headteacher, I am delighted to welcome you to Marden Vale CE Academy and I hope our website will give you an insight into life here. We are part of the Diocese of Salisbury and enjoy the support of being part of a multi academy trust. We recognise that every child is unique and work to ensure we offer the very best academic and spiritual education we can. Your child is the reason we are here.
Useful Links
Latest News
A culture of kindness, responsibility and respect We're proud to see our older pupils leading by example, supporting younger children and helping to create a school community where everyone feels valued and included 🫶
📱Fox Class have been putting their maths skills to the test using the school iPads 🔢 They tackled a range of exciting times-table-related challenges - and then once they had successfully completed the activities, they were rewarded with a game! 🤩
Dragonflies are getting ready for one of the highlights of their school year - ISing Pop! 🎶 With just over a week to go, they're getting to grips with all of the songs and actions - and growing very excited about their trip to Salisbury! 🤩
"Everyone is welcome at this school." Those words from our latest Ofsted report capture something that sits right at the heart of Marden Vale CE Academy. We are so very proud of our wonderful school
Musically-inspired mark-making by Butterfly Class 🤩🦋🎶
A proud moment for Marden Vale 💚💚💚💚💚💚💚 We are delighted to share the outcome of our recent Ofsted inspection, which has confirmed that Marden Vale is meeting the expected standard across every area of inspection. The report recognises the progress our school has made and, most importantly, captures so much of what makes Marden Vale special: our caring and inclusive culture, ambitious curriculum and the warm relationships between our pupils and staff. Inspectors highlighted that pupils make positive progress from their starting points, feel safe, enjoy their learning and are proud of their school. They also praised our work to support children with additional needs and our commitment to ensuring that every child has the opportunity to thrive. Mrs Scrivens said: "We are incredibly proud that inspectors recognised the caring, ambitious and inclusive culture we have worked so hard to build. Every child at Marden Vale deserves the very best opportunities in life." This outcome belongs to our whole school community. To our pupils, staff, families, governors and everyone who supports Marden Vale, thank you! We are incredibly proud of how far our school has come, and even more excited about where we go next. If you would like to come and see Marden Vale for yourself, we would love to welcome you. Please contact the school office on 01249 813505 or admin@mardenvale.dsat.org.uk to arrange a visit.
🏃 Kingfisher Class have been getting active in PE, developing their skipping and sprinting skills. Lots of energy, determination and fun as they put their coordination and speed to the test! 🏃
Starting school is a big adventure, and while there can be a few nerves along the way, our newest pupils have been embracing everything school life has to offer. They've been exploring their new environment, making friends, sharing and playing together, learning new routines and becoming a little more independent every day. Settling into school doesn't happen overnight, but we're already seeing confidence grow, personalities shine and lots of happy moments along the way. We hope this gives our families a little reassurance that their children are making a wonderful start to their school journey 🌟
Butterfly Class enjoyed getting creative together 🤩 They listened carefully to different types of music and let the tempo and volume guide their hands whilst drawing. A lovely way to explore how music can inspire movement, mark-making and creativity! 🎨🎵
We love being able to give our families a glimpse into everyday life at school, from classroom learning and creativity to trips, activities and special moments 📸 You may start to notice that some of the photographs we share look a little different. As part of our approach to keeping children safe online, we're being more mindful about how pupils are photographed for our public social media page. This means you'll see more photographs taken from the side, over a shoulder or from behind, rather than clearly identifiable front-facing images. These small changes mean we can continue celebrating all the wonderful things happening in school, while taking a thoughtful and responsible approach to children's privacy in an ever-changing digital world
📚 Learning at Marden Vale is about so much more than lessons 📚 We see our curriculum as the totality of a child's experience at Marden Vale Academy, helping every child to develop the knowledge, skills and confidence they need for the future. Our curriculum is ambitious, inclusive and relevant, celebrating individuality and diversity while giving every pupil opportunities to learn, grow and fulfil their potential. 🌱 If you want to read more, please visit our website: https://www.mardenvale.dsat.org.uk/curriculum
At Marden Vale, our School Values are more than just words - they are the compass that guides us. Every single day, we strive to demonstrate each of these core values
A very warm welcome back, everyone! 😊 The weather may be miserable, but it's wonderful to see so many happy, smiling faces back with us again! Looking forward to everything this new school year will bring
​​​​​​​What’s up next?​​​​​​​

Vision and Values
With God all things are possible.....Matthew 19:26 illustrated by the story of Zacchaeus (Luke 19:8-10)
‘With God all things are possible.’
The story of Zacchaeus, who realized that with God, all things are possible. Zacchaeus changed his ways and said to the Lord: “Look, Lord! Here and now, I give half of everything I have to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount.” Jesus said to him, “Today you have been saved.’
Trust – I am honest and helpful and make the right choices
Thankfulness – I am thankful for God’s love and the love of others
Perseverance – I don’t give up, I learn from my mistakes
Respect - I treat others how I wish to be treated
Compassion – I am kind, caring and show a willingness to help others
Courage – I rise to a challenge and I am brave

pageCache.text:
Christian Distinctiveness
Our Vision and Values
Our Vision Statement
Through our Christian faith we show respect, trust and compassion to all people within our school community.
Our Values
The school has six values - compassion, respect, trust, thankfulness, courage and perseverance.
These values, which are the focus of collective worship, are taught explicitly using the publication ‘Roots and Fruits’ as a starting point, and shared with parents through the school website and newsletters.
Every week, one Collective Worship is led by the local ‘Open the Book’ team, offering our children an opportunity to experience major Bible stories through storytelling and drama. Further opportunities to learn about the Bible comes through the Bible exhibitions held at Marden Vale led by the Calne Free Church.
Close links with our Parish Church enables our children to celebrate major events and Christian festivals at St. Mary the Virgin’s Church throughout the year.
Spiritual Development
At Marden Vale we seek to promote spiritual development – helping our children to know themselves better, reflect on their own experiences, explore important questions of how to live and treat others and ultimately to reach a set of beliefs and values by which to guide their lives.
Through whole school worship and class worship we offer our children opportunities:
Through all aspects of school life we aim to give our children:
to give thanks to God;
explore and express feelings and emotions;
develop respect for others;
a capacity for awe and wonder; and
Collective Worship
With God, all things are possible" - Matthew 19:26
Daily acts of collective worship are provided and through these we aim to:
Our acts of worship take place daily and will be held either in the school hall (for the whole school or key stage) or in the classrooms, school grounds or in the church. The participation and involvement of children is positively encouraged. This is achieved through the use of music, art, poetry, drama, artefacts, reflection and silence. We also include traditional elements of worship such as prayers, hymns and bible stories. Time is allowed for thought and silence and opportunities for pupil involvement.
Our daily acts of collective worship are:
Whole school worship led by staff on a rota basis
Whole school worship led by the Head Teacher / Deputy Head
Open the Book worship for the whole school
Whole singing practice led by music lead
Celebration Assembly celebrating the week's achievements in and out of school led by the Head Teacher or Deputy Head
Celebrate Christian beliefs, ideals, values and experiences.

pageCache.text:
Welcome
Welcome to Marden Vale C of E Academy
As Headteacher, I am delighted to welcome you to Marden Vale CE Academy and I hope our website will give you an insight into life here. We are part of the Diocese of Salisbury and enjoy the support of being part of a multi-academy trust. We recognise that every child is unique and work to ensure we offer the very best academic and spiritual education we can. Your child is the reason we are here.
All the staff at Marden Vale Academy are extremely hard-working and dedicated to helping all of our children achieve to the best of their abilities. I believe working in partnership with parents and the community is vital to ensure that we all succeed and thrive at Marden Vale. We value your opinions and welcome your involvement in all aspects of school life.
I would be delighted to show you round our school and introduce you to our fabulous staff team and our wonderful children. Please make an appointment through the school office.
Welcome to Marden Vale

Governance
Welcome from all the school governors. Governors are critical friends with real influence for the improvement of the young children in our school. We like to get involved to ensure that the school is upholding its ethos and strategic intent. Our responsibility is to hold the school to account for its performance, pupil success and wellbeing in a safe environment. Our role is ensuring all stakeholder voices are heard.
We are fortunate as the school already has a professional team in place who ensures its safe operation. The school relies upon the support of its parents, staff and members of the local community.
DSAT Scheme of Delegation We are members of the Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust and the governance of the Trust belongs to the main DSAT Board. Our Scheme of Delegation also includes our Constitution and Terms of Reference. Paper copies can be obtained through the school office or by using the contact us option on this website. You can find details of the Trust Board and details of our Trust Governance by visiting the Trustees page,
The Clerk/Governance Administrator to the Academy Standards and Ethos Committee is Mr Danny Holland and can be contacted by email: d.holland@dsat.org.uk
